GearModifierDef.description:
A fixed stat the gear gives while it is in its slot: a wand in the main hand, armor where it is worn. Units
follow the stat rules: ``add_value`` on one of our stats takes its unit (``amount_percent`` for a share, ``amount``
for points); multiplied operations take ``amount_percent``.

amount_percent.description: The amount in percent (5 means 5 %, the fraction 0.05).
amount_percent.title: Amount Percent

attribute.description: The attribute it modifies, e.g. realmforge:strength.
attribute.title: Attribute

operation.description: How the amount applies (vanilla's attribute modifier operations).
operation.title: Operation

GearModifierDef.title: GearModifierDef

LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

description:
One netherite upgrade: the item that carries it to the smithing table, the line the piece's tooltip shows, and
its bonus per archetype of the piece. The bonus counts while the piece is worn, in the piece's armor slot.

caster.description: The bonus on a caster piece (our netherite robes), e.g. {attribute: realmforge:spell_power, operation: add_multiplied_base, amount_percent: 5}.
caster.title: Caster

color.description: The colour of that line, "#RRGGBB": its gem's.
color.title: Color

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

item.description: The upgrade item a smithing table takes as the addition, e.g. realmforge:ruby_upgrade: one of our items that is no gear and carries no other upgrade.
item.title: Item

melee.description: The bonus on a melee piece (vanilla's netherite armor), e.g. {attribute: minecraft:attack_damage, operation: add_multiplied_base, amount_percent: 5}.
melee.title: Melee

name.description: The line the upgraded piece's tooltip shows, e.g. "Ruby Upgrade".

template.description: The smithing template the recipe takes, e.g. minecraft:netherite_upgrade_smithing_template.
template.title: Template
